svg.title: Historical cross-version numerical admissibility matrix
svg.desc: 9-version matrix with 36 off-diagonal cross-version pairs, each rejected for numerical comparison. Diagonal cells are within-version and outside this matrix.
svg.text: held out final origin five target
REJ = rejected for numerical comparison; — = same-version diagonal, not a cross-version test.
No ranking coefficient, chronological improvement, or raw Sobol-versus-IID comparison is calculated.
